entities.summary: Ronald Edmund Hutton is an Indian-born English historian specialising in early modern Britain, British folklore, pre-Christian religion, and modern paganism. A professor at the University of Bristol, Hutton has written over a dozen books, and often appears on British television and radio. He held a fellowship at Magdalen College, Oxford, and is a Commissioner of English Heritage. Ronald Hutton was a journalists & chroniclers from Ooty (b. 1953-12-19, Ooty). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
